title: The whole world is created by players
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
I'm making an online game like GTA Online, but everything is generated by the players. You prompt your own car, your own building, your own weapon.

This is the world right now, full of buildings real players made. Honestly the best part of building this is logging in and seeing what people came up with. It's slowly turning into an actual living world and that's wild to watch.

What do you guys think? Would you play something like this?

Using claude code with fable and codex for development.

You can try it here: [https://flair-3d.fly.dev/](https://flair-3d.fly.dev/)

comments.author: Grimmy66
comments.body: But do they get to change the horrible field of view?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Yes you can adjust it ;) I added the Settings after people Complained. But why do you guys think it’s annoying? I personally am a big fan of wide FOVs!

replies.author: Fun_Score5537
replies.body: 105 FOV is the sweetspot for me on 1440p monitors.

replies.author: Grimmy66
replies.body: I think its just the massive amount of warping that looses the immersion. Yes you can see more, but unless you're an owl (I suppose) real life isn't like that. Look at the difference in the size of the buildings near the edge of the screen compared to the centre.. crazy.

comments.author: Beginning-Sign1916
comments.body: Is actually pretty cool but somehow I keep getting disconnected in the first 5 - 10 secs I am on my phone right now so I will try it out later on my pc

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Yeah, it's a known issue. I'm really sorry for that. It's not yet really optimized for mobile, but on PC it everything should work.

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body: Hey I am back after testing it on my pc runs pretty smooth and I gotta say that is awesome. Just wondering will you be adding some quest in it so kinda like a builder rpg journey?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for testing ;) glad that is running smooth now! Yes I will!   
Also I will drop a super huge update today! Lots of things improved and much more Content :D

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body: That’s awesome I am looking forward to the update 😊👍🏼
